title: HARDCORE TITLE SWITCH USES THE SHARED PILL
why: The title save-row button rule overrode the shared toggle height and radius. Excluding shared toggles restores the existing 40 by 20 pill without changing settings or graveyard. Watch: check hardcore off and on beside its label at 1080p and 4K.
now: The hardcore switch keeps the shared pill shape and sliding knob on the title.

edits.anchor: #root #title #slotpanel button, #root #title #pnamein{ min-height:var(--btn-h-xs); border-radius:var(--rad) !important; font:600 var(--fs-label)/1 var(--f-cond) !important; }
edits.replacement:
/* v28.xx (cw-cx-hardcorepill): title action buttons leave shared toggles their pill size, radius and centred knob. */
#root #title #slotpanel button:not(.ui-toggle), #root #title #pnamein{ min-height:var(--btn-h-xs); border-radius:var(--rad) !important; font:600 var(--fs-label)/1 var(--f-cond) !important; }
